title: opencode-swarm plugin configuration
description: Configuration for the opencode-swarm plugin, validated from ~/.config/opencode/opencode-swarm.json and .opencode/opencode-swarm.json. Generated from PluginConfigSchema (src/config/schema.ts) by scripts/generate-config-schema.ts - do not hand-edit. Editor note: unknown top-level keys are flagged here as authoring advice; at runtime they are stripped with a warning. Sections with additionalProperties: false (strict) fail config load on unknown nested keys.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation/autocomplete of this file (issue #1663). Ignored at runtime; malformed values are ignored too.

config_format_version.description: Config format version for the migration table. Increment when fields are deprecated. Distinct from knowledge.schema_version.

agents.description: Per-agent overrides keyed by agent name for the default swarm (e.g. "architect", "coder"). Multi-swarm setups configure agents under swarms.<id>.agents instead.

default_agent.description: Agent set as the primary mode. Omitted: every generated *_architect is primary. Exact generated name (e.g. "local_architect"): only that agent. Base role name (e.g. "coder"): every generated agent with that base role. Unknown strings warn once and fall back to architect primaries.

auto_select_architect.description: Auto-select the swarm architect for new sessions instead of OpenCode built-ins. Omitted or false: manual selection (omitted behaves as false). true: enable auto-select and disable built-in build/plan agents. "<architect_name>" (e.g. "mega_architect"): enable targeting one architect in multi-swarm setups.

swarms.description: Multiple swarms keyed by swarm ID (no underscores allowed). The first swarm, or one named "default", provides the primary architect.

qa_retry_limit.description: Maximum QA retry rounds per task (1-10).

execution_mode.description: Performance mode controlling optional hook execution overhead: "strict", "balanced", or "fast".

inject_phase_reminders.description: Inject phase reminder directives during execution.

pr_review_resilience.description: PR review base-wave staged canary/fanout resilience settings.

pricing.description: Token/cost estimation fallback table. Provider-reported cost wins when present; entries only estimate from usage tokens when reports omit cost.

guardrails.description: Loop containment and safety guardrails: tool-call caps, denial tracking, destructive-command blocking, shell audit.

auto_review.description: Opt-in execution-diff review by the reviewer model in a fresh ephemeral session at task/phase boundaries.

tool_filter.description: Controls which tools each agent is allowed to use.

verifier_config_paths.description: Additional glob patterns for verifier config files that are merged into the architect agent's blockedGlobs at plugin init. Writes to matching files are blocked by the authority layer.

repo_graph.description: Repository dependency-graph settings (builder excludes, incremental refresh). Nested defaults materialize when the whole section is omitted.

design_docs.description: Structured design-doc generation (issue #1080, docs_design agent) — opt-in.

message.default: [SWARM HINT] Session has ${totalToolCalls} tool calls. Consider compacting at next phase boundary to maintain context quality.

auto_checkpoint_threshold.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to retain. Oldest checkpoints are evicted when this limit is exceeded.

automation.description: Background automation mode and per-feature toggles (v6.7 background-first rollout).

memory.description: Swarm memory substrate — disabled by default so existing flows are unchanged.

learning.description: Learning subsystem: real-time admission, PRM persistence, dedup sweep (issue #1821).

consensus.description: Consensus mining over completed run evidence (issue #1821).

curator.description: Phase context consolidation and drift detection.

knowledge_application.description: Knowledge-application contract (v2): warn or enforce modes, ack tracking.

skill_improver.description: Low-frequency, expensive-model skill improvement loop (issue #629, v2).

spec_writer.description: Spec writer agent (v2) — independent model for .swarm/spec.md authorship.

tool_output.description: Tool output truncation settings (enable/disable, max lines, per-tool overrides).

truncation_tools.description: Tools to apply output truncation to. Defaults to diff, symbols, bash, shell, test_runner, lint, pre_check_batch, complexity_hotspots, pkg_audit, sbom_generate, schema_drift.

todo_gate.description: TODO gate (v6.32): warn or block on new high-priority TODOs (FIXME/HACK/XXX).

max_high_priority.description: Max new high-priority TODOs (FIXME/HACK/XXX) before warning. 0 = warn on any. Set to -1 to disable.

block_on_threshold.description: If true, block phase completion when threshold exceeded. Default: advisory only.

council.description: Work Complete Council — parallel four-member verification gate, off by default.

parallelTimeoutMs.description: DEPRECATED — inert. Accepted for parse compatibility only; no runtime consumer exists and no timeout is enforced. Config doctor warns when this is explicitly set. Remove the key; dispatch timeouts are governed by the agent host. Scheduled for removal in a future release.

requireAllMembers.description: When true, submit_council_verdicts rejects if fewer than 5 member verdicts are provided. Equivalent to minimumMembers: 5.

minimumMembers.description: Minimum distinct council member verdicts required for synthesis (task/phase councils only — the final council uses finalCompletionPolicy). Default 3. Set to 1 to disable quorum enforcement. requireAllMembers: true overrides this to 5 (stricter constraint wins).

escalateOnMaxRounds.description: Optional webhook URL or handler name declared for escalation when maxRounds is reached without APPROVE. REMAINS INERT — no handler or webhook execution exists or is added; config doctor warns when it is set (issue #1650). Max-rounds exhaustion emits a durable structured event and a user escalation message; wiring real outbound escalation requires a separate security review.

phaseConcernsAllowComplete.description: When true, a phase-level council CONCERNS verdict with only MEDIUM/LOW findings does NOT block phase completion — the advisory notes are logged as warnings and the phase proceeds. When false, CONCERNS blocks like REJECT. Note: HIGH/CRITICAL findings from CONCERNS members are always promoted to requiredFixes and block at the tool level regardless of this setting. Default: true.

finalCompletionPolicy.description: Final-council completion policy. Missing/default is all_required (strict five-member requirement). The normalized policy participates in the council policy digest, so any change invalidates previously accepted final-council evidence.

mode.description: 'all_required' (default) preserves the exact legacy final council: all five canonical roles, five distinct members, zero absentees. 'quorum' is an explicit weakening that accepts a bounded minimum of distinct canonical members instead of all five.

minimumMembers.description: Required when mode is "quorum": minimum distinct canonical council members (3–5) that must vote. Unknown, duplicate, and cross-swarm identities never count.

freshnessMaxAgeHours.description: Maximum age (hours, 1–720) of phase-council, architecture-supervisor, and final-council evidence. Default 24 preserves prior behavior. Part of the council policy digest, so changing it invalidates prior council evidence.

parallelization.description: Parallelization (PR 1 dark foundation) — disabled by default; no production code path branches on enabled=true yet.

worktree.description: Worktree isolation policy for parallel coder dispatch lanes (general surface; Lean Turbo keeps its legacy per-mode fields).

turbo.description: Turbo execution strategy block (Phase 1). Absent means current behavior unchanged.

turbo_mode.description: Bypass reviewer/test gates for rapid iteration (v6.40).

quiet.description: Suppress non-critical startup warnings (default true keeps the TUI clean). Set false to restore verbose warnings for debugging.

version_check.description: Background staleness check against npm, throttled to once per 24h (issue #675). Set false to fully disable the network call.

full_auto.description: Full-auto autonomous orchestration with critic oversight: permission policy, denial accounting, oversight cadence triggers (v2 preserves v1 fields so existing configs load unchanged).

pr_monitor.description: GitHub PR subscription and polling (FR-001) — disabled by default; opt-in for real-time PR status updates.

external_skills.description: External skills: candidate model, discovery, and quarantine store (FR-001) — all subsystems opt-in.

skills.description: Opt-in gate for the 7 skill_* management tools (FR-004). Default false: the tools are absent from the architect tool surface.

skill_opt.description: Governed skill optimizer (issue #1822). Disabled by default; /swarm skill-opt run requires enabled: true. All other subcommands are proposal-only/read-only by default.
